metadata.name: Alanine, aspartate and glutamate metabolism (KEGG map00250)
metadata.description: Nitrogen assimilation and the amino acids made directly from central-carbon keto acids: glutamate / glutamine (GDH, GS-GOGAT, glutaminase), aspartate / asparagine, alanine, the GABA shunt, and the nitrogen glutamine and aspartate donate to carbamoyl phosphate, pyrimidines, purines, arginine and amino sugars; N-acetylaspartate / NAAG of the vertebrate brain. Derived from KEGG; drawn by GEMs MAP.

scope.note: GDH, GS, transaminases and asparagine synthesis are conserved; GOGAT (bacteria, plants, fungi), the GABA shunt, D-aspartate and NAA / NAAG (vertebrate brain) are organism-specific. Compartments are chosen by the person mapping onto a GEM.

citations.text: Kanehisa M, Goto S. KEGG: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes. Nucleic Acids Res 28:27-30 (2000)

source.generation_method: KEGG flat files + KGML (structure only) → curated biological graph → identities reconciled with MetaNetX (backend client) and the BiGG tables → hand-designed layout
